output.reason: The evidence supports the key point that, under UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025, para 261(5), any pre-payment charges “shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB.” However, the evidence does not mention “clause 7.4,” does not reference any “current RBI finding for this case,” and does not provide (or confirm the absence of) any specific “approved policy text for clause 7.4.” Therefore, only the general linkage to the UCB’s approved policy for pre-payment charges is supported; the rest of the claim is not fully supported by the evidence alone.
